summary: Implemented prepareUpdate per the spec. Changes: added Update(prologue, algebra) container in rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py; translateUpdate in algebra.py now always returns an Update, building the prologue from the single declaration group q.prologue[0] on the empty-request path; evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra; prepareUpdate added in processor.py beside prepareQuery and exported from rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py; new test/test_sparql_prepare.py covers the required behaviors. Nothing was run and nothing was committed. Unverified: test_initial_bindings_visible_to_prepared_update_operations assumes an empty WHERE clause yields the initial bindings; if it fails, check that first. The DAWG runner's pprintAlgebra now prints the list instead of hitting its AttributeError branch; it is inside a try block, so DAWG should be unaffected.
